text: "Carpentry is the skilled trade of constructing or repairing structures, such as buildings and furniture, using wood and other materials. Sawing is a crucial step, where a sharp blade is used to cut wood into precise pieces. This step provides the necessary measurements and shapes to create the desired structure. As the project progresses, the wood is carefully sanded to remove any rough edges, ensuring a functional and durable finish. Sanding also helps to remove imperfections, creating a more refined finish. By combining sawing and sanding, carpenters can bring their designs to life, crafting beautiful and reliable structures."
